description: Road surface has numerous potholes and broken patches along a long stretch.
A localized pothole is visible in the road surface with loose broken asphalt around it.
An open roadside drain contains a large accumulation of garbage and debris.
Water is standing around a partially obstructed roadside drain opening.
A long uncovered drainage channel runs through a dense roadside area.
A waste container is surrounded by a large amount of accumulated garbage.
A large pile of discarded waste has been deposited in an area marked with a no-dumping sign.
Several streetlight fixtures on the pole appear damaged or incomplete.
A strong jet of water is escaping from roadside water infrastructure onto the street.
The road surface is heavily cracked and deteriorated across a broad section.
